summary: Sierra NF lookout on Castle Peak, Madera County; built 1930 per register; a 1913 item places a lookout on 'Castle Peak or Oat Mountain' without showing the two names are one place; only six tower piers described as remaining; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan 4AR, 20-foot H-brace open steel tower
facts.status_note: Register says only six tower piers remain; removal date unknown
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Sierra National Forest

events.note: Fresno Morning Republican item (Sept 7, 1913): a fourth lookout is stationed on Castle Peak or Oat Mountain. Predates the 1930 build date
Register build year; tower described as a California Region 5 Plan 4AR, 20-foot H-brace steel
Thornton's 1986 survey suggests the structure could have been relocated to or from Oat Mountain; register says no evidence exists
Registered February 1, 2020; nominated by Brad Eells

corrections.why: Register gives the removal date as unknown and says only six tower piers remain; it does not describe the tower as gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives 1930 as the build year, but a September 1913 newspaper item already describes a lookout station on the same peak. The sources do not say whether the 1930 structure replaced an earlier station, so the record keeps 1930 as the build year and the 1913 station as a separate event.
Thornton's 1986 survey suggested the structure may have moved to or from Oat Mountain; the register says no evidence supports that. Recorded as a suggestion only.

sources.title: Castle Peak
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (volunteer lookout history site), quoting The Fresno Morning Republican

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, one of them a register entry with little detail. No staffing, fire, or access records found. The register page does not describe current conditions beyond the six piers. Search results surfaced other places that could be confused with this site: an Oat Mountain lookout in Los Angeles County and a Castle Peak near Donner Pass in Nevada County; neither is used. No photo URL was read; the register caption credits the Mark Swift Collection but no image source was recorded.
